answer: Meadow neighbor-quorum bond: each identity takes a meadow plot and locks 70 credits. Each epoch an ember beacon fires; it needs pearl attestations from 5 neighbors who checked its work. Neighbors endorse at most 3 and stake 10, slashed if false. A rented ring pays 45 credits per endorsement, so each fake costs 5 times 45 plus 70, or 295; 1,000 fakes cost 295,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest identity pays 70 once, refunded after a clean epoch.
